The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ​​Supply, installation and fixing of 300 Nos. of window curtains for 150 windows (2 curtains per window), in cluding good-quality washable polyester fabric, heavy-duty curtain rods (minimum 25 mm diameter), wall- mounted metal brackets, curtain rings, end caps, screws, wall plugs and all other necessary accessories, complete in all respects as per site dimensions and requirements. Terms and Conditions 1. Installation Location: The installation locations for the curtains shall be communicated to the successful bidder/seller by the Buyer as per the Buyer's requirements. 2. Curtain Sample Approval: The bidder shall submit a physical sample of the proposed curtain fabric/mate rial for inspection and approval by the Buyer before opening of the tender. The sample shall conform to th e required specifications. The decision of the Buyer regarding sample acceptance shall be final. 4. Submission of Company Documents: The bidder shall upload all relevant company documents along wit h the tender, including company registration certificate, GST registration certificate, PAN card and other a

pplicable statutory documents. 5. Self-Undertaking for Installation: The bidder shall upload a duly signed and stamped self-undertaking co nfirming their willingness and capability to supply and install the specified items at the locations designat ed by the Buyer. The undertaking shall mention the item description but must not disclose or include any quoted price. 6. Completeness of Bid: The bidder shall ensure that all required documents, declarations, undertakings a nd samples are submitted within the stipulated timeline. Incomplete bids or failure to comply with the abo ve conditions may lead to rejection of the bid. .
